name: Action 2 Code
definition: Specifies which type of action a user should take.

SBTW.name: Submit Twin
SBTW.definition: Request to submit a twin baseline.

RSTW.name: Re Submit Twin
RSTW.definition: Request to resubmit a twin baseline.

ARDM.name: Accept Or Reject Data Set Mis Matches
ARDM.definition: Request to accept or reject mismatched data set(s).

ARCS.name: Accept Or Reject Change Of Status
ARCS.definition: Request to accept or reject a request for a change of status of the baseline.

ARES.name: Accept Or Reject Extension Of Status
ARES.definition: Request to accept or reject a request for an extension of the period of validity of the status of the baseline.

WAIT.name: Wait For Baseline Established
WAIT.definition: Request to wait until the baseline is established.

ARBA.name: Accept Or Reject Baseline Amendment
ARBA.definition: Request to accept or reject a request for a baseline amendment.

ARRO.name: Accept Or Reject Baseline And Role
ARRO.definition: Request to accept or reject a baseline and the role contained in it for the financial institution.

CINR.name: Check Invoice Reference
CINR.definition: Request to check invoice number because it was not found.
